notes: Your bench, squat and hinge reps could come back with sprint faults they never had: the fault picker ran the running checks on every activity, so a bench press with your feet planted ahead of your knees was called ‘Overstriding’, and the top of a squat or hinge — knees straight, thighs parallel, the correct shape — was called ‘Foot recovery’ or ‘Thigh separation’, and the report sent you sprint drills for a lift that was fine. Overstriding, foot recovery and thigh separation are now only called on running — sprints, drills and block starts — so a lift rep names its own fault (squat depth, hinge back, knee tracking) or no fault at all. Real sprint faults still trip exactly as before.
